728-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
728-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

1981-2415-2438-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-6719.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1172-7442.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Torment of Hailfire by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana. Each opponent will lose 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card for each mana paid beyond the {B}{B}.
1172-7442.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Torment of Hailfire. While the opponents can sacrifice permanents and/or discard cards to prevent lifeloss, they'll eventually run out of cards/permanents if enough mana is poured into Torment of Hailfire.

884-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1495-4613-7691.description:
Activate The Thing by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Thing triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
6797-6972-7607.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2528-5088-5231-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-5088-5231-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

891-3055-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

4559-4659-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4659-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-2307-5921.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {2}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Walking Ballista resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

129-2464-4824.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
129-2464-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-2464-4824.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

413-3239-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
When Haywire Mite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Haywire Mite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-2034-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-2034-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes on Sin.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger, untapping it.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

1978-3430-4289.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1978-3430-4289.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

2634-2928-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-2928-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least two +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-5872.description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by 1.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
3693-4120-5872.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 3 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

560-2034-2835-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2034-2835-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

397-5670-6097.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5670-6097.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

440-1339-1545-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1545-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-5231-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Fiendish Panda, adding {R}.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1458-2585-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-2585-5864.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3090-4691-5919.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

3719-4200-5912.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
3719-4200-5912.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Icewind Stalwart and create at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing three Treasures, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
3719-4200-5912.notes: If you have four or more experience counters, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1379-1558-1908-3667.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Evangel of Heliod with haste.
When the Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-3685-4497-4694.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3685-4497-4694.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield as a creature due to March of the Machines, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

709-1627-2232-4772-4852.description:
Cast Tyvar by paying {2}{G}{G}, which enters with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tyvar's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Tyvar dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Tyvar ability, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Elvish Mystic spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Elvish Mystic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Llanowar Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Llanowar Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Llanowar Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Elvish Mystic from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 5.

1656-2987-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-2987-4762.description:
Tap Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's ability to add {G}.
Untap Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's ability, giving it a -1/-1 counter.
Tap Necrotic Ooze and remove a -1/-1 counter use Channeler Initiate's ability to add {1} of any color.
Repeat for infinite mana.

1999-2636-2898-5129.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2636-2898-5129.description:
Cast Aeon Engine by paying {5}.
Aeon Engine enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Aeon Engine.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Aeon Engine to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Untap all permanents you control during each opponent's untap step due to Unwinding Clock.
Activate the token copy of Aeon Engine by tapping and exiling it, reversing the game order.
On your turn, repeat from step 1.

4821-5261.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
4821-5261.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dramatic Reversal without paying it's mana cost.
Resolve Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat.
